key_points: Nike issued a soft full-year forecast and reported a 12% decline in China sales, overshadowing its Q4 earnings beat.
S&P downgraded Nike's credit rating to 'A' citing China weakness and turnaround drag on cash flow.
Barron's downgraded the stock to Sell, warning of a potential 13-year low for shares.
Jefferies maintains optimism for a Q1 earnings beat and sees Nike's recovery story intact despite short-term pressure.
Weak guidance has altered the investment thesis, raising concerns about near-term revenue trends.
